elements.description:
A reading list set in a citation style – APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard or IEEE – with links, tags, search, sort,
Copy for one or the selected, and export as BibTeX, RIS or plain text.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the list's name

properties.name: citationStyle
properties.description: The citation style (not `style`, which every element has for CSS). Changed by the user unless tc-citation-style-change is prevented

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The ticked references' ids. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

properties.name: sort
properties.description: The order. Changed by the user unless tc-sort-change is prevented

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Shows only references whose authors, title, container, year or tags hold this

properties.name: filename
properties.description: The name exported files are saved under, before the extension

properties.name: shown
properties.description: The references shown: filtered, then sorted

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-citation-style-change
events.description: The citation style changed ({ citationStyle }: BibliographyCitationStyleChange); cancelable – prevented, `citationStyle` stays as it was

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: References were ticked or unticked ({ selected }: BibliographySelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

events.name: tc-sort-change
events.description: The order changed ({ sort }: BibliographySortChange); cancelable – prevented, `sort` stays as it was

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: A reference, or the selected ones, were copied ({ text, ids }: BibliographyCopy); cancelable – prevented, nothing is copied

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export was chosen ({ format, text, ids }: BibliographyExport); cancelable – prevented, the page saves it its own way; otherwise the file downloads

functions.name: formatReference
functions.signature: formatReference(ref: Reference, style: CitationStyle, n?: number): string
functions.description: A reference as plain text in a citation style; `n` numbers it for IEEE

functions.name: formatReferenceTemplate
functions.signature: formatReferenceTemplate(ref: Reference, style: CitationStyle, n?: number): TemplateResult
functions.description: A reference in a citation style as a template: titles in italics where the style sets them so, DOI / URL as links

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the list's name

props.name: citationStyle
props.description: The citation style – controlled when given

props.name: defaultCitationStyle
props.description: The style on mount when `citationStyle` isn't controlled

props.name: selected
props.description: The ticked references' ids – controlled when given

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The ticked references on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: The order on mount when `sort` isn't controlled

props.name: onCopyReferences
props.description: References were copied; `event.preventDefault()` stops the copy

props.name: onExport
props.description: Export was chosen; `event.preventDefault()` to save it your own way

changelog: **Research & portfolio** - **Roadmap Timeline** (`tc-roadmap-timeline`) – Gantt-style lanes with progress, milestones, Today and dependency arrows, at week, month or quarter scale. - **Prioritisation Matrix** (`tc-prioritisation-matrix`) – value against effort, points dragged or moved with the arrow keys, listed by quadrant. - **Risk Register** (`tc-risk-register`) – a 5 × 5 likelihood × impact grid beside a sortable, rescorable register. - **Bibliography** (`tc-bibliography`) – references in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard or IEEE, with Copy and BibTeX / RIS export.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
